description: This donut chart, titled “Task Type,” visually represents the distribution of two distinct task categories within the context of generative AI’s use in journalism, as presented in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” The chart is composed of two slices, each corresponding to a specific task type. The larger, dominant slice, colored red, represents “Article generation” and accounts for 83.2% of the total. The smaller, adjacent slice, colored yellow, represents “Headline generation” and constitutes 16.8% of the total. Both percentage values are explicitly labeled outside their respective segments, and the chart includes a central label “Task Type” to indicate the categorical variable being displayed. The segments are arranged in a clockwise descending order by size, with the larger “Article generation” slice positioned on the left and the smaller “Headline generation” slice on the right.
